sub_question: Identify legislators who are male and represent Louisiana.
sub_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT l.full_name
FROM legislators AS l
JOIN legislators_terms AS lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
WHERE l.gender = 'Male' AND lt.state = 'Louisiana';

sub_question: Find the start date of each identified legislator's first term.
sub_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, l.full_name
    FROM legislators AS l
    JOIN legislators_terms AS lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'Male' AND lt.state = 'Louisiana'
    GROUP BY l.id_bioguide, l.full_name
)
SELECT b.full_name, MIN(lt.term_start) AS first_term_start
FROM base b
JOIN legislators_terms lt ON b.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
GROUP BY b.id_bioguide, b.full_name;

sub_question: For each calendar year, compute how many full years have passed from the start of the first term to December 31 of that year.
sub_sql:
WITH first_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(term_start) AS start_date
    FROM legislators_terms
), years AS (
    SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', start_date) AS INTEGER) AS calendar_year,
           start_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT calendar_year + 1, start_date
    FROM years
    WHERE calendar_year + 1 <= CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT calendar_year,
       calendar_year - CAST(strftime('%Y', start_date) AS INTEGER) AS full_years_passed
FROM years;

sub_question: Keep only those years where the elapsed time is greater than 30 years and less than 50 years.
sub_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE first_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(term_start) AS start_date
    FROM legislators_terms
), years AS (
    SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', start_date) AS INTEGER) AS calendar_year,
           start_date
    FROM first_start
    UNION ALL
    SELECT calendar_year + 1, start_date
    FROM years
    WHERE calendar_year + 1 <= CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT calendar_year,
       calendar_year - CAST(strftime('%Y', start_date) AS INTEGER) AS full_years_passed
FROM years
WHERE (calendar_year - CAST(strftime('%Y', start_date) AS INTEGER)) > 30
  AND (calendar_year - CAST(strftime('%Y', start_date) AS INTEGER)) < 50;

sub_question: Verify that each legislator was still in office on December 31 of those years.
sub_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT lt.id_bioguide,
       b.calendar_year
FROM base b
JOIN legislators_terms lt
  ON date(lt.term_start) <= date(b.calendar_year || '-12-31')
 AND (lt.term_end IS NULL OR date(lt.term_end) >= date(b.calendar_year || '-12-31'))

sub_question: Count the distinct legislators that satisfy the above conditions for each specific elapsed year value.
sub_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE leg_start AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS start_date
    FROM legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
), first_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(start_date) AS global_start
    FROM leg_start
), years AS (
    SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', global_start) AS INTEGER) AS calendar_year
    FROM first_start
    UNION ALL
    SELECT calendar_year + 1
    FROM years
    WHERE calendar_year + 1 <= CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT (years.calendar_year - CAST(strftime('%Y', leg_start.start_date) AS INTEGER)) AS elapsed_years,
       COUNT(DISTINCT leg_start.id_bioguide) AS legislator_count
FROM years
JOIN leg_start ON (years.calendar_year - CAST(strftime('%Y', leg_start.start_date) AS INTEGER)) BETWEEN 30 AND 50
GROUP BY elapsed_years
ORDER BY elapsed_years;

sub_question: Organize the counts by the exact number of years elapsed since the first term.
sub_sql:
WITH leg_start AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS start_date
    FROM legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
)
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', start_date) AS INTEGER)) AS elapsed_years,
       COUNT(*) AS legislator_count
FROM leg_start
GROUP BY elapsed_years
ORDER BY elapsed_years;
